title: Let a workspace that declares a root twice own it
summary: ia preview and ia author judged an authored root one declaration row at a time, so a workspace that declares the same root both `@authored` and `@adopted` (the adopted twin a governing store keeps for adopters) was refused IA-CLI-EDIT-UNOWNED at its own root. Ownership is now judged per declaring workspace: every declarer must declare the root `@authored`, and a declarer that holds only the `@adopted` twin still withholds it.
